title: Audit console: provenance sampling and canonicalized export schema
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Deliver a robust audit viewer export flow that preserves event provenance, is RBAC v2 aware, and produces a canonical CSV/JSON schema usable for downstream compliance tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Console search UI allows saving queries with lineage metadata (who saved, origin filter set, created_at)
Export endpoint returns canonicalized JSON and CSV with deterministic column order and provenance fields (request_id, source_node, auth_method)
Exports respect RBAC v2 filtering: users only receive events they are authorized to see, including redaction markers when partial redaction applies
Pagination supports cursor and time-window slices with stable checkpoint tokens for long-running exports
Saved queries surface last-run metadata and can be shared with link tokens scoped by admin/owner permissions
tasks: Define canonical export schema and column ordering (CSV/NDJSON)
Add provenance fields to audit pipeline (request_id, origin_cluster, auth_hint)
Implement RBAC v2 filter pass-through to export microservice
Console UX: saved query lineage display and shareable scoped links
Backend: cursored windowed export job with checkpointing and resumable downloads
Write e2e tests for redaction and permissioned exports
Prepare migration script for historical logs to add provenance keys where missing

decision_log: Prefer canonical CSV with deterministic ordering to simplify downstream diffs and audit tooling (vs ad-hoc column order)
Expose redaction metadata as explicit columns instead of omitting values so automated parsers can detect policy effects
Use checkpoint tokens (opaque) rather than page offsets to support efficient resumable exports when logs shift under export jobs
pagination_strategy: cursored time-window slices with opaque checkpoint token and optional prefetch window
notes_for_reviewers: Security review must validate that SSO/SAML 'auth_hint' mapping is complete and that RBAC v2 filters are applied at the exporter boundary to avoid overexposure. Perf team to run 48-hour job with simulated tenant load before approving release.
